segments.t: Now
segments.note: δέ「Now」。Ἐγένετο（1番）は定型で英語に現れない

segments.t: in those days,
a decree went out
from Caesar Augustus
that all the world should be enrolled.
segments.note: 「that...should be enrolled」は ἀπογράφεσθαι の意訳

segments.t: This was the first enrollment made
segments.note: 「made」は英語の補い

segments.t: when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
segments.note: ἡγεμονεύοντος τῆς Συρίας Κυρηνίου「when Quirinius was governor of Syria」

segments.t: All went to enroll themselves,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: everyone to his own city.
Joseph also went up
segments.note: δέ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth,
into Judea, to David’s city,
which is called Bethlehem,
because he was of the house and family of David,
to enroll himself
with Mary,
who was pledged to be married to him
as wife,
segments.note: 「as wife」は WEB の補足。ギリシャ語本文に対応する語はない

segments.t: being pregnant.
While they were there,
segments.note: ἐγένετο δὲ（1–2番）は定型で英語に現れない

segments.t: the day had come for her to give birth.
segments.note: 「the day」は αἱ ἡμέραι（複数）を単数で訳したもの

segments.t: She gave birth to her firstborn son.
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: She wrapped him in bands of cloth
segments.note: 「bands of cloth」は ἐσπαργάνωσεν の内容を展開したもの

segments.t: and laid him in a feeding trough,
because there was no room for them in the inn.
There were shepherds in the same country
segments.note: 冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: staying in the field,
segments.note: ἀγραυλοῦντες「staying in the field」

segments.t: and keeping watch by night over their flock.
Behold,
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い ἰδοὺ を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: an angel of the Lord stood by them,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: and the glory of the Lord shone around them,
and they were terrified.
segments.note: ἐφοβήθησαν φόβον μέγαν「大いに恐れた」の意訳

segments.t: The angel said to them,
“Don’t be afraid,
segments.note: 「be」は英語の補い

segments.t: for behold, I bring you good news of great joy
segments.note: 「good news」は εὐαγγελίζομαι に含まれる

segments.t: which will be to all the people.
For there is born to you today,
segments.note: 「there」は形式主語

segments.t: in David’s city,
a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
This is the sign to you:
you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”
segments.note: 「strips of cloth」は ἐσπαργανωμένον の展開

segments.t: Suddenly,
segments.note: ἐξαίφνης「Suddenly」。冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army
praising God and saying,
“Glory to God in the highest,
on earth peace,
good will toward men.”
When the angels went away from them into the sky,
segments.note: 冒頭の Καὶ ἐγένετο は定型で英語に現れない

segments.t: the shepherds said to one another,
“Let’s go to Bethlehem, now,
segments.note: 「now」は δὴ

segments.t: and see this thing that has happened,
segments.note: 「thing」は ῥῆμα

segments.t: which the Lord has made known to us.”
They came with haste
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: and found both Mary and Joseph,
and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.
segments.note: 「was」は英語の補い

segments.t: When they saw it,
segments.note: 「they」は ἰδόντες に含まれる。δέ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.
segments.note: 「widely」は ἐγνώρισαν（告げ知らせる）の意訳に含まれる

segments.t: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.
segments.note: 句全体の対応。「things」は τῶν λαληθέντων

segments.t: But Mary
kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God
for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.
When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child,
segments.note: 冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない。「the child」は αὐτόν の明示

segments.t: his name was called Jesus,
which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
segments.note: 「given」は κληθὲν の意訳

segments.t: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled,
segments.note: 冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord
(as it is written in the law of the Lord,
“Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),
and to offer a sacrifice
according to that which is said in the law of the Lord,
“A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”
Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon.
segments.note: 冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel,
and the Holy Spirit was on him.
It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: that he should not see death
before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
He came in the Spirit into the temple.
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,
then he received him into his arms
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない。「then」は英語の補い。「his」は ἀγκάλας への補い

segments.t: and blessed God, and said,
“Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;
segments.note: 句全体の対応。「you are releasing」は ἀπολύεις（現在形）

segments.t: for my eyes have seen your salvation,
segments.note: 句全体の対応

segments.t: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;
segments.note: 句全体の対応。「before the face of」は κατὰ πρόσωπον の直訳的表現

segments.t: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”
segments.note: 句全体の対応

segments.t: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.
segments.note: 「Joseph」は ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ の明示的意訳。冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: Simeon blessed them,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: and said to Mary, his mother,
“Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.
segments.note: 「child」は οὗτος の明示。「is appointed」は κεῖται の意訳

segments.t: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul,
segments.note: 「Yes」は καὶ…δὲ の意訳

segments.t: that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher
segments.note: 冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,
and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years),
segments.note: 「about」は ἕως の意訳に伴う補い

segments.t: who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.
Coming up at that very hour,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: she gave thanks to the Lord,
segments.note: 「the Lord」は τῷ θεῷ を WEB が言い換えたもの

segments.t: and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.
segments.note: 「in Jerusalem」は λύτρωσιν Ἰερουσαλήμ（エルサレムの贖い）の意訳

segments.t: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord,
segments.note: 冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.
The child was growing, and was becoming strong
segments.note: δέ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: in spirit,
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「in spirit」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: being filled with wisdom,
and the grace of God was upon him.
His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.
segments.note: 句全体の対応。冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: When he was twelve years old,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast;
segments.note: 「to Jerusalem」は文脈からの補い

segments.t: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem.
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,
segments.note: 「Joseph and his mother」は οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ の展開訳

segments.t: but supposing him to be in the company,
segments.note: 「but」は δὲ

segments.t: they went a day’s journey;
and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.
When they didn’t find him,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.
After three days they found him
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ ἐγένετο は定型で英語に現れない

segments.t: in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers,
both listening to them and asking them questions.
segments.note: 「both」は καὶ…καὶ。「questions」は ἐπερωτῶντα の内容

segments.t: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
segments.note: δέ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: When they saw him, they were astonished;
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: and his mother said to him,
“Son, why have you treated us this way?
Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”
He said to them,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: “Why were you looking for me?
Didn’t you know that I must be
segments.note: 「that I must be」は ὅτι…δεῖ εἶναί με

segments.t: in my Father’s house?”
segments.note: ἐν τοῖς τοῦ πατρός μου「in my Father’s house」は慣用表現

segments.t: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.
segments.note: 句全体の対応。冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth.
He was subject to them,
and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
segments.note: 句全体の対応
